summary: Fresh-migration verification of FixJadi/Anyar wedding gallery. Backend: 15/15 pytest cases passed (public clients, client detail, settings, admin login+session gating, admin CRUD, invalid Drive link 400, settings PUT+reset, upload require-admin + upload/fetch round-trip). Frontend: Home renders 6 seeded gallery cards; opening a gallery shows title + 28 photos with clickable lightbox; Admin route works with wrong PIN (shows 'PIN salah'), correct PIN 246810 logs in and reveals admin dashboard (6 Klien Wedding, 162 Total Foto), and logout returns to PIN screen. No blocking issues found.
critical_code_review_comments: backend_test.py at repo root (/app/backend_test.py) was stale (hardcoded old PIN 123456 and hardcoded brand assertions). Replaced by /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py — consider deleting the root-level file to avoid confusion.
Drive poller is started unconditionally at boot even when GOOGLE_DRIVE_API_KEY is empty; it logs benign warnings. Not a bug but consider a no-op guard when the key is missing.

admin/uploads endpoint returns url as '/api/uploads/{id}' (relative). Fine because frontend proxies /api, but on external preview, consumers should join with backend base. Not an issue for current UI.
seed_data_creation: Used existing seed (6 clients / 162 photos). Test-created clients and setting mutations are cleaned up / reset by the tests themselves.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend suite lives at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py and runs from /app/backend via pytest. It relies on REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL env var (falls back to preview_endpoint then localhost:8001). Admin PIN read from ADMIN_PIN env, default 246810. Frontend testids to reuse: clients-grid, gallery-title, gallery-photo-grid, gallery-photo-item, album-grid, admin-pin-input, admin-pin-error, admin-pin-submit-btn, admin-add-client-btn, admin-logout-btn, admin-client-row. Google Drive sync is intentionally disabled (empty GOOGLE_DRIVE_API_KEY); do not test live drive sync.
